title: Here’s Where To Buy Affordable Tickets to Kacey Musgraves’ Middle of Nowhere 2026 Tour Online
summary: The tour is in support of the country singer's sixth studio album of the same name.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In support of her sixth studio album, Kacey Musgraves is heading out on the Middle of Nowhere tour this fall.

The musician’s Middle of Nowhere 2026 tour will commence on Aug. 21 in Chicago, Ill., at United Center before making stops all across the U.S., including shows in Boston, Baltimore, Kansas City, Phoenix and Los Angeles. The tour will conclude in Seattle at the Climate Pledge Arena on Oct. 27. Tickets to Musgraves’ 2026 tour went on sale to the general public on Friday, May 8, via Ticketmaster .

Musgraves scored the highest debut of her career with Middle of Nowhere, charting at number three on the Billboard 200 — moving 100,000 units in its first week. The project surpassed her 2024 album Deeper Well , which opened with 97,000 units. This tour will likely focus primarily on tracks from Middle of Nowhere , from fan-favorites like “Dry Spell” and “Coyote” to “Loneliest Girl.”

Below, we’ll be showing you where you can buy affordable tickets to Musgraves’ 2026 tour. We’ve also included promo codes to bump pricing down further.

Where to Buy Affordable Tickets to Kacey Musgraves’ Middle of Nowhere 2026 Tour

OFFICIAL TICKETING

Ticketmaster

find tickets here

General admission for Musgraves’ tour went on sale Friday, May 8, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time via Ticketmaster . The site has a slew of tickets still available post-general sale, with pricing going for as low as $50.55 at some venues. The ticketing service offers a fan guarantee, which allows for cancellations, refunds or exchanges within 24 hours of booking. However, these options are subject to certain exclusions.

EDITOR'S PICK

StubHub

A great third-party option for buying Musgraves tickets is StubHub . With a quick look, we’ve seen tickets going for as low as $73. StubHub often has great deals on ticket sets, marking them down with deals for you and a friend up to 44% off .

For example, a set of tickets available for Musgraves’ Boston show retails for $130, down from $235. The site will mark specific venues with these deals, utilizing a “great value” badge so you won’t miss out on markdowns.

To help you plan your ticket-buying approach, StubHub will notify ticket buyers which venues are selling out fastest. The platform makes buying tickets easy with its “FanProtect Guarantee,” which protects purchases with authentic tickets and refund policies. Plus, if your event is canceled and not rescheduled, you will receive a credit worth 120% of the amount you paid, or the option of a cash refund.

PROMO CODES

SeatGeek

More options for affordable ticketing to Musgraves’ tour can be found on SeatGeek . A quick click through the website reveals tickets for the singer’s tour going for as low as $60 . To make ticketing even more affordable on SeatGeek , you can use promo code BILLBOARD10 at checkout to receive $10 off. The ticketing service features a buyer guarantee that ensures easy ticket purchases every time.

EARN REWARDS

Vivid Seats

Another great option is Vivid Seats. At the time of publication, Musgraves ‘ tickets are selling for as low as $59 at venues like the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, NY. The site has some of the lowest pricing we’ve seen on our search thus far, beyond Ticketmaster.

If you’re looking to make ticketing on Vivid Seats even more affordable, you can use our promo code BB30 to snag $30 off your purchase. The ticketing service offers a 100% buyer guarantee that vows your transaction will be secure, that your tickets will be delivered before your event, and that those tickets will be valid and authentic. 

PROMO CODE

TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork is yet another option we’ve found that has pretty affordable ticketing to Musgraves’ tour . Pricing starts at $63 at some venues, a steal when compared to pricing via other ticketing sites. When you search for tickets on TicketNetwork, you can use our code BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1,000 or more, or code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off orders of $500 or higher.

LOWEST PRICING

Gametime

Gametime is a third-party site with really great pricing on Musgraves’ tour . As we searched through the site, we found pricing starting in the $60 range for venues in Milwaukee, Brooklyn and Chicago to make shopping for the perfect ticket even easier, Gametime will notify you when certain venues and dates are discounted. You’ll see indicators on your search that will tell you which venues are in high demand, a helpful tool for preplanning your attack plan when purchasing tickets.

When purchasing tickets through Gametime , the ticketing site guarantees that buyers are protected in the event that their concert is unexpectedly canceled. Tickets will arrive on time at the most affordable price. If you do happen to find lower pricing elsewhere, Gametime will hook users up with 110% of the difference.
